{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-dhx8","title":"lollipop_cmp: linear region values >16 apart incorrectly treated as incomparable","description":"Location: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py lines 72-101, lollipop_cmp function

Bug: RFC 6550 Section 7.2 specifies that for lollipop counter values both in the linear region (0-127), simple unsigned integer comparison should be used. However, the implementation uses serial arithmetic (mod-128 with SEQUENCE_WINDOW=16) for all same-region comparisons, causing values that differ by more than 16 to be treated as incomparable.

Reproduction: versions_incomparable(5, 100) returns True (WRONG: should be False). version_is_newer(100, 5) returns False (WRONG: should be True).

Impact: During initial DODAG formation (versions 0-127), nodes with version differences >16 reject each others DIOs as incomparable, delaying or preventing convergence. A rebooted node at version 0 cannot join a network at version 50.

Fix: Add a branch in lollipop_cmp for same-region linear comparison - if both values are in linear region, use simple unsigned comparison instead of serial arithmetic.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-27T22:14:28.699839Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-27T22:14:28.699839Z","labels":["codereview","rpl","correctness"]}
